one_line_description: Command-line interface for Mermaid.js that compiles text-based markdown diagram syntax into SVG, PNG, and PDF formats.

authentication.other: No authentication required; local Node.js CLI tool

credential_access.notes: Open-source Node.js package (@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli) with MIT license; installed via npm.

mcp.notes: Community MCP wrapper servers exist on GitHub; mermaid-cli itself is an npm CLI binary.

buildability.blocker: No hosted SaaS API; runs as local executable or CLI process
buildability.rationale: Integration must execute in a local sandbox or CLI subprocess rather than via cloud API requests.

evidence.title: Mermaid CLI GitHub Repository
evidence.excerpt: mermaid-cli is a command-line tool that takes a mermaid definition file and outputs an SVG, PNG, or PDF file. It runs locally via Node/npm without a hosted web API.
